purpose: Prevent stale composites, legacy matrices, generated convenience assets, or friendly filenames from masquerading as current visual authority.
production_rule: A character-bearing renderer input is authoritative when either (A) mounted source bytes freshly hash to the approved expected_sha256, or (B) for OpenAI native image generation, the exact registered canonical Library file_id is directly bound through NATIVE_RENDER_REFERENCE_BINDING_V1.json. Path B proves canonical-handle binding, not fresh byte re-hashing; expected_sha256 remains provenance authority and visible raster Character QA remains mandatory. Semantic visual conflicts listed in source_visual_conflicts MUST block either path A or B even if the original filename, approved SHA or Library handle matches.
derived_asset_rule: A generated or composite asset may never become PRIMARY_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY by filename/tag. Promotion requires an explicit Commissioner-approved source supersession recorded in canon and a new approved SHA-256.
